plan.scope: Flattening followed automatically by folding, then scale reveal. Released robots return to home through a separately identified scripted kinematic presentation tail.

hero_evidence.geometry: Shared original PIPER rigid visuals, independent true FK poses, Catmull-Clark visual subdivision on every cloth. Physical task state sampling is unchanged.
hero_evidence.kinematics: One shared CPU FK model. True recorded generalized positions and root poses; zero velocities are internal position-only FK placeholders, not claimed source velocities.
hero_evidence.scope: Saved task motion through the verified released endpoint, followed by a scripted kinematic return of the released robot arms to configured home. Cloth terminal state is held during this presentation-only return; it is not claimed as autonomous policy motion or physics evaluation. Not live generation throughput.

presentation_return.arm_target: Configured robot home_joint_q; grippers remain released.
presentation_return.cloth: Successful terminal state held during scripted kinematic return.
presentation_return.scope: Presentation choreography, distinct from recorded autonomous behavior and physics evaluation.
